description: A dim, vaulted stone room resembling a converted church, painted in oil. On the left stands an upright piano and beside it an upright double bass. In the centre, a brass trumpet with a small cup-shaped mute rests on a folding wooden chair, and a vintage microphone hangs on a boom stand overhead. Music stands and cables fill the shadowy background, lit by one hanging lamp. No text, frame or people are visible.
